gloss: escaping the winter cold; wintering in a warm place

definitions.gloss: escaping the winter cold; spending winter in a warm place
definitions.explanation: Leaving a cold region to spend the winter somewhere milder, or avoiding the worst of the cold. The winter counterpart of {避暑|ひしょ} (escaping the summer heat).

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{避寒|ひかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: to go to Okinawa to escape the cold

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{避寒|ひかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather spends every winter in a warm region.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{南国|なんごく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{滞在|たいざい}して→滞在する：26834_taizaisuru⟧{避寒|ひかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people stay at a hotel in the tropics for the winter just to escape the cold.

notes:
The winter counterpart of ⟦{避暑|ひしょ}→避暑：16476_hisho⟧ (escaping the summer heat). Refers to leaving a cold area to spend the winter somewhere milder.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {避寒|ひかん}{地|ち}: winter resort; place for escaping the cold
- {避寒|ひかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go away to escape the cold
- {避寒|ひかん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: a trip to escape the winter cold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{避暑|ひしょ}→避暑：16476_hisho⟧: escaping the summer heat — the summer counterpart
